_readme: Plan for 30 more topics (B1 extra, B2, C1, C2). Same JSON structure as supermarket.json, including the 'dialogue' field. Keywords are chosen by the writer: 20 useful words/phrases for the situation at the topic's CEFR level.

topics.title: Renting a Car
topics.description: Book a rental car, understand insurance, and deal with problems on the road.
topics.grammarFocus: have to / need to / don't need to / mustn't for rules and obligations
topics.storyIdea: A couple rents a car for a road trip and discovers a scratch they didn't make when returning it.

topics.title: Making a Complaint
topics.description: Complain politely and firmly to get a refund, a repair, or an apology.
topics.grammarFocus: Polite complaint language: I'm afraid..., I'd like to..., Would it be possible to...?
topics.storyIdea: A customer's new washing machine breaks after a week and she calls customer service.

topics.title: Healthy Lifestyle
topics.description: Talk about food, sleep, stress, and healthy habits.
topics.grammarFocus: Zero conditional and gerunds as subjects (Eating late makes me tired)
topics.storyIdea: A software developer changes his habits after feeling tired all the time.

topics.title: Neighbors & Community
topics.description: Get along with neighbors, solve small problems, and take part in your community.
topics.grammarFocus: Common phrasal verbs (get along with, put up with, turn down, look after)
topics.storyIdea: A new tenant has a noisy neighbor and they end up becoming friends.

topics.title: Travel Problems
topics.description: Handle lost luggage, delays, missed connections, and overbooked hotels.
topics.grammarFocus: Past perfect for earlier events (When I arrived, the plane had already left)
topics.storyIdea: A traveler misses a connecting flight and his suitcase goes to another city.

topics.title: Social Media
topics.description: Talk about posts, privacy, online friends, and screen time.
topics.grammarFocus: Reported speech (She said that..., He told me to...)
topics.storyIdea: A teenager's post goes viral and her parents and friends react differently.

topics.title: Volunteering & Charity
topics.description: Talk about helping others, charities, and community projects.
topics.grammarFocus: Verb + gerund or infinitive (enjoy helping, decide to join, stop to help)
topics.storyIdea: A group of friends organizes a food drive in Ramadan for families in need.

topics.title: Negotiating a Deal
topics.description: Make offers, push back politely, and reach an agreement.
topics.grammarFocus: Conditionals for negotiating: unless, provided that, as long as, on condition that
topics.storyIdea: A freelance designer negotiates price and deadline with a demanding client.

topics.title: Giving a Presentation
topics.description: Structure a talk, guide the audience, and handle questions.
topics.grammarFocus: Signposting language and impersonal passive (It is estimated that..., As you can see...)
topics.storyIdea: A nervous engineer presents a new product to the board and a tough question changes the plan.

topics.title: Climate & Environment
topics.description: Discuss climate change, recycling, energy, and what individuals can do.
topics.grammarFocus: Future continuous and future perfect (By 2050 we will have...)
topics.storyIdea: A city in Egypt starts a project to reduce plastic, and a student joins the campaign.

topics.title: University & Studying Abroad
topics.description: Apply to universities, talk about courses, scholarships, and student life abroad.
topics.grammarFocus: Non-defining relative clauses and participle clauses
topics.storyIdea: An Egyptian student gets a scholarship in Germany and adapts to a new academic culture.

topics.title: News & Current Affairs
topics.description: Discuss news stories, sources, and fake news.
topics.grammarFocus: Reporting verbs (claim, deny, admit, warn, suggest) and their patterns
topics.storyIdea: A journalist checks a viral story and discovers it is fake.

topics.title: Relationships & Conflict
topics.description: Talk about friendships, misunderstandings, apologies, and making up.
topics.grammarFocus: wish / if only for regrets (I wish I hadn't said that)
topics.storyIdea: Two old friends stop talking after a misunderstanding and finally meet to clear the air.

topics.title: Starting a Business
topics.description: Talk about ideas, funding, customers, and growth.
topics.grammarFocus: Modals of deduction about the past (must have, might have, can't have)
topics.storyIdea: Two developers launch an app, and after a slow start they find out why users were leaving.

topics.title: Technology & AI
topics.description: Discuss AI, automation, privacy, and how technology changes jobs.
topics.grammarFocus: Advanced passive and causative (have something done, get something fixed, is being developed)
topics.storyIdea: A small company starts using an AI assistant and the team debates its pros and cons.

topics.title: Leadership & Management
topics.description: Lead a team, delegate, give feedback, and manage change.
topics.grammarFocus: Inversion for emphasis (Not only..., Rarely have I..., Under no circumstances...)
topics.storyIdea: A newly promoted team lead must handle a conflict between two senior engineers.

topics.title: Debating & Persuasion
topics.description: Build arguments, counter opposing views, and persuade an audience.
topics.grammarFocus: Cleft sentences for emphasis (What I'm arguing is..., It is this that...)
topics.storyIdea: A university debate team argues whether social media does more harm than good.

topics.title: Economy & Personal Finance
topics.description: Discuss inflation, investment, budgeting, and economic trends.
topics.grammarFocus: Hedging and cautious language (it would appear that, tends to, is likely to)
topics.storyIdea: A young couple rethinks their budget and investments during a period of high inflation.

topics.title: Law & Rights
topics.description: Understand contracts, consumer rights, and legal procedures.
topics.grammarFocus: Formal register and nominalisation (the termination of the contract)
topics.storyIdea: A tenant reads the fine print of a contract and challenges an unfair clause.

topics.title: Psychology & Wellbeing
topics.description: Talk about emotions, burnout, motivation, and mental health.
topics.grammarFocus: The subjunctive and 'It is essential/vital that...'
topics.storyIdea: A high-achieving professional recognizes the signs of burnout and seeks help.

topics.title: Culture & Identity
topics.description: Discuss traditions, multiculturalism, language, and belonging.
topics.grammarFocus: Concession and contrast (albeit, nonetheless, whereas, much as)
topics.storyIdea: An Egyptian family living in Canada balances two cultures during Eid.

topics.title: Academic Writing & Research
topics.description: Write and discuss research: sources, methods, findings, and limitations.
topics.grammarFocus: Academic phrasing and passive with modals (It could be argued that..., This may be attributed to...)
topics.storyIdea: A master's student defends her research method in front of a strict supervisor.

topics.title: The Future of Work
topics.description: Discuss remote work, gig economy, automation, and work-life balance.
topics.grammarFocus: Future forms for prediction and speculation (bound to, set to, on the verge of)
topics.storyIdea: A company debates returning to the office after years of remote work.

topics.title: Idioms in Everyday Talk
topics.description: Understand and use common idioms naturally in conversation.
topics.grammarFocus: Idiomatic expressions and fixed phrases in context
topics.storyIdea: A newcomer in a London office gets confused by idioms until a colleague explains them.

topics.title: Diplomacy & Tactful Language
topics.description: Say difficult things politely: disagree, refuse, and give bad news tactfully.
topics.grammarFocus: Softening and indirectness (I was wondering whether..., It might be worth considering...)
topics.storyIdea: A manager has to reject a loyal employee's proposal without hurting the relationship.

topics.title: Literature & Art
topics.description: Discuss novels, films, paintings, and critical opinions with nuance.
topics.grammarFocus: Nuanced evaluative language and advanced modifiers (strikingly, somewhat, utterly)
topics.storyIdea: Two critics disagree about a controversial new Egyptian novel at a book club.

topics.title: Ethics & Moral Dilemmas
topics.description: Discuss right and wrong, responsibility, and difficult choices.
topics.grammarFocus: Mixed and complex conditionals (If I had known, I would be... / Were it not for...)
topics.storyIdea: A doctor must decide whether to report a colleague's serious mistake.

topics.title: Science & Innovation
topics.description: Discuss discoveries, research, breakthroughs, and their impact.
topics.grammarFocus: Nominalisation and dense noun phrases typical of scientific English
topics.storyIdea: A research team's surprising result is first rejected, then confirmed by others.

topics.title: Humor, Sarcasm & Wordplay
topics.description: Recognize sarcasm, irony, understatement, and puns.
topics.grammarFocus: Irony and understatement (Well, that went well. / It's not exactly cheap.)
topics.storyIdea: An Egyptian engineer misreads a British colleague's sarcasm, then learns to enjoy it.

topics.title: Global Affairs & Politics
topics.description: Discuss international relations, policy, and global challenges in a balanced way.
topics.grammarFocus: Formal hedging and stance markers (arguably, ostensibly, it remains to be seen)
topics.storyIdea: Delegates at an international water conference try to reach a compromise.
